title: Apple (AAPL) Stock Rating Reaffirmed by Citigroup
text:
Apple (AAPL) Stock Rating Reaffirmed by Citigroup Posted by Joy Tochi on Feb 6th, 2019 Tweet
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) ‘s stock had its “buy” rating reissued by investment analysts at Citigroup in a research report issued to clients and investors on Wednesday, January 30th. They currently have a $170.00 target price on the iPhone maker’s stock. Citigroup ‘s target price indicates a potential downside of 2.43% from the company’s current price.
Several other brokerages have also recently issued reports on AAPL. JPMorgan Chase & Co. restated a “buy” rating and issued a $228.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, January 11th. Royal Bank of Canada restated a “buy” rating and issued a $185.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, January 18th. Rosenblatt Securities set a $165.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research note on Thursday, December 6th. Morgan Stanley raised their price objective on Apple from $226.00 to $253.00 and gave the stock an “overweight” rating in a research note on Thursday, November 8th. Finally, UBS Group cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating in a research note on Friday, November 2nd. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-three have issued a hold rating and twenty-two have issued a buy rating to the stock. The stock currently has an average rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $191.66. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of AAPL traded up $0.06 during midday trading on Wednesday, reaching $174.24. 27,975,180 shares of the stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 32,522,028. Apple has a 52 week low of $142.00 and a 52 week high of $233.47. The company has a current ratio of 1.30, a quick ratio of 1.25 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.79. The company has a market capitalization of $841.72 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 14.63, a PEG ratio of 1.75 and a beta of 1.13.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $4.17 by $0.01. Apple had a return on equity of 50.92% and a net margin of 22.72%. The business had revenue of $84.31 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $84.07 billion. On average, equities research analysts predict that Apple will post 11.39 EPS for the current year.
In other news, Director Arthur D. Levinson sold 1,521 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, February 1st. The stock was sold at an average price of $167.71, for a total transaction of $255,086.91. Following the completion of the transaction, the director now directly owns 1,134,804 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $190,317,978.84. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available at this hyperlink . Also, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . 0.05% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders.
Several hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently made changes to their positions in the stock. Capco Asset Management LLC raised its stake in shares of Apple by 30.7% during the 4th quarter. Capco Asset Management LLC now owns 115,199 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $18,171,000 after buying an additional 27,078 shares in the last quarter. Berkshire Money Management Inc. raised its stake in shares of Apple by 8.3% during the 4th quarter. Berkshire Money Management Inc. now owns 5,351 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $844,000 after buying an additional 410 shares in the last quarter. Roanoke Asset Management Corp NY raised its stake in shares of Apple by 70.9% during the 4th quarter. Roanoke Asset Management Corp NY now owns 4,337 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $684,000 after buying an additional 1,800 shares in the last quarter. Graybill Bartz & Assoc Ltd. raised its stake in shares of Apple by 7.1% during the 4th quarter. Graybill Bartz & Assoc Ltd. now owns 30,311 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,781,000 after buying an additional 1,999 shares in the last quarter. Finally, NorthCoast Asset Management LLC raised its stake in shares of Apple by 685.1% during the 4th quarter. NorthCoast Asset Management LLC now owns 135,683 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $21,403,000 after buying an additional 118,400 shares in the last quarter. 57.00% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
